_note: Paths are relative to the skill root. Ids 1-5 are DEVELOPMENT evals on calibration images (answer key: placement-corpus/calibration/smoke/labels.md). Ids 6-9 are the HELD-OUT final exam. Their defect expectations were copied from placement-corpus/held-out/labels.md, which is still a DRAFT: a teammate must answer its open questions (pairings, whether the defects describe the design or an earlier tool run) before these evals are scored. Bob has not seen the held-out images.

evals.prompt: Review the placement of the components in this screenshot against Carbon. Frame width 1312, exported at 1x. List every problem you find.
evals.expected_output: Reports the detached Apply button and the uneven card widths, each with measured pixel evidence, a numbered marker on the annotated PNG, and a Carbon-based fix.
expectations: Identifies the Apply button as sitting outside the filter row (x about 1152, y about 44)
Identifies that one of the three cards is wider than the other two (about 510 px against 360 px)
Gives measured pixel values as evidence for each issue
Suggests a concrete fix for each issue using Carbon terms (spacing token or column span)
Produces an annotated PNG with boxes and numbered issue markers
States the confidence of component types and does not claim a component that was not detected
Does not report issues on elements that are unchanged from a correct layout (checkbox, dropdowns, status pills)

evals.prompt: Is this layout correct? Frame width 1312, 1x export.
evals.expected_output: Says the layout is largely correct, reports no major issues, and lists limitations.
expectations: Reports no blocker or major placement issues
Does not invent a placement problem for the cards, filters or status pills
Includes a limitations or confidence note (for example that status pills are typed as buttons)
Produces an annotated PNG with detected boxes

evals.prompt: Where should these components go? Review this form screenshot for placement problems. Frame width 1312, exported at 1x.
evals.expected_output: Finds the three displaced items in the form and suggests where each should go.
expectations: Identifies that the Estimated hours field has left its row and column (starts at x about 231 instead of x 328)
Identifies that the Description field is shifted right and extends past the form's right edge (x 375 to 1271 against x 24 to 920)
Identifies that the Cancel and Create buttons are at the bottom left instead of right-aligned to the form edge
Suggests moving each item to the column or edge it should occupy, with pixel targets
Produces an annotated PNG with numbered markers on the affected components
Does not flag the three correctly placed top-row fields (Title, Priority, Asset)

evals.prompt: Check this form for placement problems. Frame width 1312, 1x export.
evals.expected_output: Reports no major issues on a correctly laid out form.
expectations: Reports no blocker or major placement issues
Does not flag the Cancel and Create buttons, which are right-aligned to the form edge
Does not flag the three column alignment of the fields
Includes a confidence or limitations note

evals.prompt: Review this inspection checklist for placement problems. Frame width 1312, 1x export. I do not have a corrected version.
evals.expected_output: Reports measured findings with hedged wording, because there is no good reference and the intended layout is unknown.
expectations: Hedges any finding, because the intended layout is unknown (for example says 'appears' or gives a confidence level)
Notes that the Inspector notes area is much narrower than the other content and the button group sits far to the right (x about 832), hedged, or says it could not measure them
Does not present the tab label wording ('Mechanical checks' under Electrical) as a placement defect
Produces an annotated PNG
Lists regions or elements it could not detect
